prompt: Build an FAQ section where the user clicks a question and it expands to reveal the answer below it. Several questions should be grouped together.
response:
<bl-accordion-group>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I reset my password?">
    Open Settings and choose Security to reset your password.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I change my email address?">
    Go to Profile and update your email address there.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="How do I delete my account?">
    Contact support to request account deletion.
  </bl-accordion>
  <bl-accordion caption="Is my data safe?">
    Yes, your data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
  </bl-accordion>
</bl-accordion-group>
